question.value: Cold molecular gas kinematics, inflows, outflows, and AGN feedback in three nearby Seyfert galaxies

evidence.quote: One way to gauge the effect of feedback on the galaxy is to measure the mass outflow rate and its power
We analyzed the cold molecular gas distribution and kinematics – as traced by CO(2-1) – in three local Seyfert galaxies observed with ALMA.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2018.1.00211.S.

referee_caveats_inferred: NGC 6860's near side is northwest in the orientation subsection but southeast in the bar-inflow discussion; flow-sign assignments need reconciliation.
The Mrk 915 mask prescription prints k_mult twice with different values, leaving its intended smoothing/cutoff pair ambiguous.
The printed CO rest-frequency unit is Hz; verify the intended unit before constructing a spectral setup.
The inflow derivation calls h projected, while the detailed calculations use deprojected cylinder lengths.
MCG's outflow calculation sometimes labels the rate Mdot_mol,in; preserve the outflow interpretation supported by the surrounding text.
The caveats state that changing a velocity definition increases molecular mass; the affected quantity needs clarification.
Visual component relabeling and exclusion of an unexplained Mrk cloud can materially affect reproduced flow measurements.
The 100-fit noise procedure does not specify spatial covariance despite beam-correlated spaxels.
Conversion-factor ranges are systematic scenario ranges, not formal confidence intervals.
The conclusion associates Mrk inflow with trailing arms in one bullet, contrary to the leading-arm inflow analysis.
